newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Intel EPS views raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Intel EPS views raised.

text.p: -- Salomon Bros analyst Erika Klauer said in a research note that she raised her 1996 Intel Corp earnings estimate to $5.30 per share from $4.70 and the 1997 estimate to $7.00 per share from $6.00.

-- Her hold recommendation remains unchanged because of valuation and the possibility that Intel's new pricing strategy "may have encouraged heavy ordering in September and October. These record levels may not be sustained into the November and December months."
-- Intel shares were up 3-1/8 to 110-3/4 in midsession Nasdaq trade, off an all-time high of 114-1/4 reached earlier in the day.
